lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: STAY BACK OR I SWEAR THE WHOLE BASEMENT IS COMING DOWN ON OUR HEADS [beat] DON'T TOUCH THOSE FILES NIX!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: YOU WERE THE ONE WHO CUT THE SUPPORT BEAMS [beat] YOU TRAPPED US BOTH IN THIS DEATH TRAP JUST TO HIDE THE PRINCIPAL'S GRADE-FIXING SCANDAL!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: IT'S NOT A SCANDAL IF NO ONE SURVIVES THE COLLAPSE [beat] BRUNO JUST HAND OVER THE KEYCARD AND WALK AWAY THROUGH THE VENT!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: NIX CAN YOU HEAR ME UNDER THERE [beat] THE FIRE DEPARTMENT IS TEN MINUTES AWAY BUT THE FOUNDATION IS CRACKING RIGHT NOW!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: SHE'S LYING TO YOU NIX [beat] HUDA NEVER INTENDED FOR ME TO ESCAPE EITHER BECAUSE I KNOW TOO MUCH ABOUT HER SECRET ACCOUNTS!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: THE PRINCIPAL ISN'T JUST STEALING GRADES [beat] SHE'S EMBEZZLING THE SCHOOL CONSTRUCTION FUND FOR HER OWN PRIVATE ISLAND!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: YOU LITTLE BRATS THINK YOU'RE SO SMART [beat] BUT THE CEMENT IS POURING INTO THE VENTILATION DUCTS AS WE SPEAK!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: THEY'RE PUMPING LIQUID CONCRETE INTO THE BASEMENT [beat] NIX YOU HAVE TO CLIMB UP THE ELECTRICAL CONDUIT BEFORE IT'S TOO LATE!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: BRUNO GIVE ME YOUR HAND [beat] IF WE DON'T MOVE IN THE NEXT FIVE SECONDS WE'RE BOTH BECOMING PART OF THE SCHOOL FLOORING!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: THE FILES ARE TOO HEAVY TO CARRY WHILE CLIMBING [beat] I CAN'T BELIEVE I'M SAYING THIS BUT LEAVE THEM AND SAVE YOURSELF!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I'M NOT LEAVING WITHOUT THE PROOF [beat] EVEN IF THE ROOF CAVES IN EVERYONE WILL FINALLY SEE WHAT HUDA REALLY IS!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: ENJOY YOUR PERMANENT DETENTION UNDER FIVE TONS OF SLUDGE [beat] THE TRUTH BURIES WITH THE BRAVE!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: WAIT [beat] BRUNO WHAT ARE YOU DOING WITH THAT EMERGENCY FLARE NEAR THE GAS LINE?

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: IF WE'RE GOING DOWN [beat] WE'RE TAKING THIS ENTIRE CORRUPT OFFICE BUILDING TO THE MOON WITH US!
